svg.title: Square values for move ordering
svg.desc: Two heat maps of the 64 square values. Left: the static values, 127 on the corners, -64 on the X-squares, -32 on the C-squares and small values inside. Right: the values after the squares next to each corner are recomputed for a position where Black owns a1 and White owns h8 and f8.
svg.text: Square values used for move ordering (higher = searched earlier)
For Black, with Black on a1 and White on h8 and f8
Own corner a1: b1 and a2 become 34, b2 becomes 24. Empty corners h1 and a8: C-squares −16, X-square −64.
White's corner h8: g8 is 32 because the next edge square f8 is White's, h7 is −32 because h6 is not; g7 is −16.
